name: Flamestar Post
summary: Flamestar Post is a small outpost situated just south of the bridge connecting the Burning Steppes to Blackrock Mountain. Maintained under the watchful eye of the Thorium Brotherhood, this rugged camp offers travelers and sellswords an initial foothold against the menacing Blackrock clan.

sections.title: A Foothold Near the Mountain
sections.body: Positioned within sight of Blackrock Mountain's smoking ramparts, Flamestar Post provides a precarious staging ground amid the volcanic wastes. The camp is overseen by the Thorium Brotherhood, the renegade Dark Iron smiths who broke away from their brethren inside the mountain. Seeking skilled hands rather than political allegiances, the Brotherhood welcomes capable adventurers here to supply their efforts and push back against the aggressive Blackrock orcs who dominate the surrounding slag heaps.

faq.answer: Flamestar Post sits in the western reaches of the Burning Steppes, immediately south of the massive stone bridge leading into Blackrock Mountain.
The outpost is run by the Thorium Brotherhood, an independent faction of Dark Iron dwarves who operate outside the direct control of their kin within Blackrock Mountain.

faq.q: What is the primary danger surrounding the camp?
faq.answer: The post is constantly menaced by the Blackrock clan orcs and their fiery allies, who vigorously patrol the approaches to Blackrock Mountain and hunt any interlopers entering the Steppes.

faq.q: Why does the Thorium Brotherhood operate here?
faq.answer: Having abandoned the dark masters within Blackrock Mountain, the Thorium Brotherhood uses outposts like this to gather materials, hire mercenaries, and combat the hostile forces entrenched in the volcanic crags.

angles.text: The Thorium Brotherhood overseeing this post holds legendary knowledge of fiery craft and exotic metallurgy, making any connection to their camps invaluable to aspiring armorers and weaponsmiths.
